# Else Statement

An `else` statement runs code when the condition in an `if` statement is not true. Use `else` when you want your app to do one thing if a condition is true and a different thing if it is false.
name: Else Statement
tips:
- Use `else` after an `if` statement.
- The code inside `else` only runs when the `if` condition is false.
- Do not put a condition after `else`.
- Use curly braces `{ }` to hold the code that should run.
- In Web Lab, `else` is often used to choose between two screen updates.
